scope: Asia 47 countries; specification targets are not tested implementations

countries.title: CHINA — Zhangjiajie Sky Pillars
countries.signatureMechanic: Moving cliff lifts and precise high-altitude traversal
countries.environment: Create an enormous landscape of tall sandstone pillars rising through misty valleys. Use sculpted stone columns with vegetation growing on their upper surfaces. The foreground should contain wet-looking rock ledges, small trees, hanging roots, and natural stone paths. Place enormous mountain pillars in the background at different depths. Use soft clouds drifting between the columns. The environment should feel much taller than Japan's forested cliffs.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a wide mountain observation terrace. The player crosses a stone path, climbs progressively higher ledges, rides a moving cliff platform, crosses a narrow rocky connection, and reaches a high observation point. The main route should include several safe resting ledges between difficult jumps.
countries.optionalRoute: Create an elevated route across narrow pillar tops. Place a golden star on a remote observation platform. The bonus route reconnects before the finish.
countries.discovery: Teach the player about Wulingyuan's distinctive sandstone pillar landscape.
countries.visualRequirement: China must be defined by extreme verticality, layered mountain pillars, and mist. It must not look like the same Japanese floating-rock level with different trees.

countries.title: JAPAN — Cherry Blossom Mountain Path
countries.environment: Preserve the existing Japan level. Maintain Mount Fuji, cherry blossom trees, traditional Japanese-inspired architecture, waterfalls, torii gates, stone lanterns, and grassy platforms. Improve the 3D terrain geometry, water, lighting, and background depth to match the approved cinematic reference.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a broad grassy island. Cross a simple gap, continue along a wooden bridge, traverse wide natural stone platforms, and finish at a scenic gateway.
countries.optionalRoute: Create an ascending route of irregular grassy rocks leading to a floating golden star. The player should be able to return safely to the main path.
countries.discovery: Mount Fuji and the Japanese landscape.
countries.visualRequirement: Japan should remain the visual benchmark for the game but must not become the standard layout copied across Asia.

countries.title: MONGOLIA — Endless Steppe Expedition
countries.signatureMechanic: Wind-assisted traversal and moving ground obstacles
countries.environment: Create vast grasslands under a huge blue sky. Include rolling green and golden hills, distant mountains, winding river sections, and scattered rock outcrops. Traditional ger structures may appear as background cultural references in appropriate locations. The scenery should be open, with very few tall structures. Avoid dense forests and large floating islands.
countries.mainRoute: The player runs across broad grassy terrain, crosses shallow gullies, moves over natural stone ledges, and traverses a short river crossing. The route should feel expansive and mostly horizontal.
countries.optionalRoute: Place a star on a small isolated hilltop reached through a series of short jumps.
countries.discovery: Mongolia's steppe environment and traditional pastoral landscapes.
countries.visualRequirement: Mongolia must feel wide, open, and horizontal—the opposite of China's narrow vertical climbing.

countries.title: NORTH KOREA — Mount Paektu Highlands
countries.environment: Create an alpine volcanic landscape with a large crater lake visible in the distance. Use dark volcanic rock, rugged ridgelines, sparse high-altitude vegetation, snow patches, and cool atmospheric lighting. Add distant mountains and clouds. Keep the level focused on physical geography rather than politics.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a broad volcanic ridge. Travel over rocky ledges, cross a narrow mountain pass, climb several natural steps, and follow a descending path toward the finish viewpoint.
countries.optionalRoute: An elevated overlook contains a star and a view of the crater lake.
countries.discovery: Mount Paektu's volcanic landscape and crater lake.
countries.visualRequirement: The environment should be geographically distinctive, with volcanic highland geology rather than generic snowy mountains.

countries.title: SOUTH KOREA — Seoul Skyline Adventure
countries.environment: Create a stylized Seoul city scene featuring a modern skyline, tree-lined streets, bridges, and N Seoul Tower in the background. Use modern building materials, illuminated signs, rooftop gardens, and architectural variation. Traditional hanok-inspired buildings may appear in a separate historic district section, but do not mix distant districts into one inaccurately literal streetscape.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a rooftop terrace. Cross a short pedestrian structure, ride a moving maintenance lift, traverse two building terraces, and descend toward a riverside finish.
countries.optionalRoute: An elevated rooftop garden contains a star.
countries.discovery: Seoul's urban geography and the Han River.
countries.visualRequirement: South Korea should feel like a modern, layered urban adventure rather than another mountain level.

countries.title: BRUNEI — Ulu Temburong Canopy Expedition
countries.environment: Create dense tropical rainforest with towering trees, deep green foliage, river valleys, and mist-covered hills. Use raised wooden walkways and canopy-observation structures inspired by rainforest exploration infrastructure. The background should contain several layers of rainforest canopy.
countries.mainRoute: The player begins at a forest research platform, crosses a suspension bridge, climbs a short wooden observation tower, and uses a moving platform to reach the next section. The main route should be safe and moderately elevated.
countries.optionalRoute: A higher canopy walkway contains a star and extra coins.
countries.discovery: Borneo rainforest biodiversity.
countries.visualRequirement: Brunei should emphasize elevated canopy walkways, not Brazil's vine-swinging traversal.

countries.title: CAMBODIA — Angkor Forest Ruins
countries.environment: Create Khmer architectural forms inspired by Angkor, including towers, sandstone passages, galleries, reservoirs, and large tree roots surrounding ruined structures. Use weathered stone, moss, tropical trees, and warm filtered light. Keep actual protected temples as scenic landmarks; place gameplay obstacles in fictional nearby structures.
countries.mainRoute: Begin in a courtyard, traverse a raised stone passage, activate a floor switch, open a gate, and reach a garden corridor.
countries.optionalRoute: An optional elevated gallery contains a star.
countries.discovery: Angkor's architectural and historical significance.
countries.visualRequirement: Cambodia should have a dense architectural puzzle structure, not a generic forest obstacle course.

countries.title: INDONESIA — Mount Bromo Volcanic Expedition
countries.location: Bromo Tengger Semeru volcanic landscape, East Java
countries.signatureMechanic: Periodic steam vents and unstable ash-rock surfaces
countries.environment: Create dark volcanic mountains, ash-covered slopes, a broad volcanic plain, drifting mist, and distant crater formations. Use charcoal gray, warm mineral brown, and muted green materials.
countries.mainRoute: Start on a wide volcanic plain. Climb a sequence of rocky slopes, pass through a steam-vent section, cross a narrow volcanic ridge, and reach a crater observation platform.
countries.optionalRoute: A more difficult high rock passage contains a star.
countries.discovery: Volcanic processes and Indonesia's position along active tectonic zones.
countries.visualRequirement: Indonesia must emphasize volcanic geology rather than rainforest or generic floating islands.

countries.title: LAOS — Kuang Si Waterfall Journey
countries.location: Kuang Si Falls near Luang Prabang
countries.environment: Create beautiful multi-tier waterfalls, turquoise pools, forested limestone formations, and wooden footbridges. Use lush vegetation, damp moss, and flowing streams.
countries.mainRoute: The player begins along a forest path, crosses a stream, climbs small limestone terraces, and uses a slowly moving platform near a waterfall.
countries.optionalRoute: A higher forest overlook contains a star.
countries.discovery: The natural waterfall landscape and limestone pools.
countries.visualRequirement: Laos must emphasize terraces and flowing water rather than large canyon cliffs.

countries.title: MALAYSIA — Mount Kinabalu Highlands
countries.environment: Create an ecological transition from lush montane forest to rugged high-elevation granite landscapes. Use dense lower vegetation, cloud layers, steep mountains, and pale granite formations.
countries.mainRoute: Begin in a forested mountain section. Travel upward through rocky paths, use limited climbable surfaces, cross an exposed ridge, and reach a high observation platform.
countries.optionalRoute: An optional ledge climb contains a star.
countries.discovery: Mount Kinabalu's biodiversity and mountain ecology.
countries.visualRequirement: Malaysia should emphasize a change in elevation and vegetation within one level.

countries.title: MYANMAR — Bagan Plains Adventure
countries.environment: Create a broad plain with historic temple silhouettes, dry-season trees, warm sunlight, and weathered brick textures. Keep protected historical structures in scenic areas. Construct fictional walkable courtyards and terraces inspired by regional architecture.
countries.mainRoute: The player travels through a market-inspired walkway, crosses low terraces, activates a mechanism, and reaches an elevated observation point.
countries.optionalRoute: A fictional raised gallery provides an optional star.
countries.discovery: Bagan's historical landscape.
countries.visualRequirement: Myanmar should feature a wide historic plain and numerous distant structures rather than one enormous central monument.

countries.title: PHILIPPINES — Banaue Rice Terrace Challenge
countries.signatureMechanic: Water-channel gates and vertical terrace jumps
countries.environment: Create an enormous stepped agricultural mountain landscape. Use green rice terraces, earthen retaining walls, irrigation channels, misty mountains, and small village structures.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a broad terrace. Climb successive terrace levels, cross a small irrigation canal, activate a water gate, and reach a higher overlook.
countries.optionalRoute: A narrow upper terrace leads to a star.
countries.discovery: Rice terrace engineering and agricultural heritage.
countries.visualRequirement: The repeated geometry should come from the real stepped-terrace landscape, but platform spacing must still be individually designed and varied.

countries.title: SINGAPORE — Futuristic Garden City
countries.location: Marina Bay / Gardens by the Bay-inspired environment
countries.environment: Create a stylized futuristic urban garden with sculptural tree-like structures, landscaped terraces, glass buildings, water features, and the Marina Bay skyline. Use original walkable structures inspired by modern garden architecture.
countries.mainRoute: Begin in a landscaped plaza, ride a vertical lift, traverse an elevated garden walkway, and descend toward a waterfront finish.
countries.optionalRoute: A high glass observation platform contains a star.
countries.discovery: Singapore's urban green spaces and waterfront development.
countries.visualRequirement: Singapore should feel clean, futuristic, and engineered rather than natural or ancient.

countries.title: THAILAND — Phang Nga Limestone Islands
countries.environment: Create tall limestone karsts rising from turquoise-green water, coastal vegetation, small beaches, and distant islands. Use water reflections and mist between rock formations.
countries.mainRoute: The player crosses a rocky coastal path, rides a small boat platform, jumps across limestone ledges, and climbs to a viewpoint.
countries.optionalRoute: A higher isolated karst ledge contains a star.
countries.discovery: Thailand's coastal limestone landscapes.
countries.visualRequirement: Thailand should emphasize tall rock islands and seawater, rather than the reef-focused environment used for Australia.

countries.title: TIMOR-LESTE — Atauro Island Coastal Expedition
countries.environment: Create rocky tropical shores, clear blue water, coastal hills, fishing village structures, and coral-rich marine scenery. Use a bright open atmosphere.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a wide coastal trail, cross a simple wooden pier, make two short island-platform jumps, and reach a scenic beach overlook.
countries.optionalRoute: A low optional rock island contains a star.
countries.discovery: Atauro Island's marine environment.
countries.visualRequirement: Timor-Leste should be gentle, scenic, and accessible rather than another demanding ocean obstacle course.

countries.title: VIETNAM — Ha Long Bay Floating Islands
countries.signatureMechanic: Moving boat platforms and alternating elevation routes
countries.environment: Create mist-covered limestone islands emerging from green-blue water. Include small boats, coastal vegetation, caves, and distant karst silhouettes.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a limestone shoreline, ride a moving boat, climb natural rock ledges, pass through a short cave section, and reach a high viewpoint.
countries.optionalRoute: An optional upper cave exit leads to a difficult star route.
countries.discovery: Ha Long Bay's limestone karst geography.
countries.visualRequirement: Vietnam should combine water travel, caves, and limestone ascent in one connected route.

countries.title: AFGHANISTAN — Band-e Amir Lake Expedition
countries.signatureMechanic: Narrow mineral terraces and controlled water crossings
countries.environment: Create blue lakes separated by natural mineral terraces, rugged mountains, dry rock formations, and clear high-altitude light.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a broad lakeside rock path, cross elevated natural terraces, traverse a short stone bridge, and climb to a scenic overlook.
countries.optionalRoute: A higher limestone ledge provides a star.
countries.discovery: Band-e Amir's natural lakes and mineral formations.
countries.visualRequirement: Use a peaceful natural landscape. Avoid conflict imagery, weapons, or military themes.

countries.title: BANGLADESH — Sundarbans Mangrove Journey
countries.environment: Create mangrove forests, intertwined roots, muddy riverbanks, shallow waterways, and boats.
countries.mainRoute: The player crosses a wooden boardwalk, steps over small root obstacles, rides a slow floating platform, and finishes at a forest observation station.
countries.optionalRoute: A raised wooden lookout contains a star.
countries.discovery: Mangrove ecosystems and their coastal importance.
countries.visualRequirement: Avoid turning real wildlife, including tigers, into enemies.

countries.title: BHUTAN — Paro Mountain Cliff Adventure
countries.signatureMechanic: High cliff traversal and moving mountain lifts
countries.environment: Create forested Himalayan cliffs, dramatic mountain valleys, traditional Bhutanese architectural forms, and a distant monastery integrated into a cliff.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a forest path, climb successive rocky ledges, traverse a suspension bridge, and follow an elevated mountain trail.
countries.optionalRoute: A demanding rocky overlook contains a star.
countries.discovery: Bhutan's mountain geography and traditional architecture.
countries.visualRequirement: Keep religious buildings as protected scenic landmarks rather than destructible or hostile game objects.

countries.title: INDIA — Taj Mahal Garden Adventure
countries.environment: Create pale marble-inspired architecture, red sandstone, symmetrical gardens, fountains, flowerbeds, and long water channels. Place the Taj Mahal clearly in the distance.
countries.mainRoute: Begin in a garden courtyard, cross carved stone bridges, use a moving platform over a water channel, and reach a garden overlook.
countries.optionalRoute: A raised fictional pavilion contains a star.
countries.discovery: Taj Mahal architecture and its historical context.
countries.visualRequirement: Do not make the protected monument itself part of a destructive platforming obstacle.

countries.title: IRAN — Yazd Windcatcher City
countries.environment: Create earthen architecture, traditional wind towers, narrow lanes, courtyards, roof terraces, and desert-colored structures.
countries.mainRoute: The player travels through a historic-inspired street, climbs onto broad fictional rooftop terraces, uses a rising platform, and crosses a shaded courtyard.
countries.optionalRoute: A higher terrace provides a star and city panorama.
countries.discovery: Traditional windcatcher architecture and passive cooling.
countries.visualRequirement: Iran should be identified by its architectural geometry, not by generic sand dunes.

countries.title: MALDIVES — Coral Lagoon Island Adventure
countries.environment: Create white sandy islands, shallow turquoise lagoons, coral formations, palm trees, and clear tropical skies.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a wide sandy island, cross a short wooden dock, jump across a few low rock platforms, and reach a coastal finish.
countries.optionalRoute: A small optional island contains a star.
countries.discovery: Coral reef ecology and island geography.
countries.visualRequirement: Create a bright, low-elevation environment without tall mountains or oversized cliffs.

countries.title: NEPAL — Himalayan Suspension Trail
countries.signatureMechanic: Suspension bridges and advanced cliff traversal
countries.environment: Create towering Himalayan peaks, snow-covered rock, mountain valleys, alpine vegetation, and trail infrastructure.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a rocky trekking path, climb steep ledges, cross a suspended bridge, traverse a mountain ridge, and reach a high lookout.
countries.optionalRoute: A precision-jump trail leads to a star.
countries.discovery: Himalayan mountain formation and geography.
countries.visualRequirement: Nepal should have dramatic vertical terrain and suspension-trail structures, distinct from Bhutan's forested cliff setting.

countries.title: PAKISTAN — Hunza Valley Expedition
countries.signatureMechanic: Long suspension crossings and moving rock platforms
countries.environment: Create steep rocky mountains, the distinctive Passu Cones skyline, mountain rivers, terraced settlements, and glacial valleys.
countries.mainRoute: The player begins on a rocky trail, crosses a narrow suspension structure, climbs mountain ledges, and descends toward a river viewpoint.
countries.optionalRoute: An upper rock crossing contains a difficult star.
countries.discovery: Hunza Valley's dramatic mountain geography.
countries.visualRequirement: Avoid treating Pakistan as a generic desert; focus on its northern high-mountain environment.

countries.title: SRI LANKA — Sigiriya Gardens Adventure
countries.environment: Create the towering Sigiriya rock formation, surrounding jungle, ornamental garden areas, water features, and historic architectural references.
countries.mainRoute: Start in a garden, cross water channels, climb fictional stone terraces near the main rock, and finish at a scenic overlook.
countries.optionalRoute: A higher observation platform contains a star.
countries.discovery: Sigiriya's historical and landscape significance.
countries.visualRequirement: Keep the protected archaeological site visually recognizable and avoid damage-based gameplay.

countries.title: KAZAKHSTAN — Charyn Canyon Expedition
countries.signatureMechanic: Natural ledges and timed falling stones
countries.environment: Create large red and orange canyon formations, stratified cliffs, dry valleys, and sparse vegetation.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a high overlook, descend a sequence of broad ledges, cross a narrow canyon bridge, and finish on the valley floor.
countries.optionalRoute: An elevated rock lookout contains a star.
countries.discovery: Charyn Canyon's geology.
countries.visualRequirement: Kazakhstan should emphasize layered canyon formations rather than the open steppes of Mongolia.

countries.title: KYRGYZSTAN — Ala-Archa Alpine Climb
countries.environment: Create green alpine valleys, rocky mountain slopes, pine forests, glacial streams, and snowy peaks.
countries.mainRoute: Begin beside a mountain stream, climb rocky ledges, cross a bridge, and reach a high alpine viewpoint.
countries.optionalRoute: An optional icy ridge contains a star.
countries.discovery: Kyrgyzstan's alpine landscapes.
countries.visualRequirement: Use greener mountain valleys than the higher, arid Pamir environment planned for Tajikistan.

countries.title: TAJIKISTAN — Pamir Mountain Challenge
countries.signatureMechanic: Narrow ledges, wind, and vertical climbing
countries.environment: Create high rugged mountains, broad rocky valleys, sparse vegetation, snow-covered peaks, and dramatic high-altitude skies.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a mountain trail, cross a steep rocky pass, climb several narrow ledges, and descend to a final observation point.
countries.optionalRoute: An advanced upper-ridge path contains a star.
countries.discovery: The Pamir Mountains and their geographic significance.
countries.visualRequirement: Tajikistan must emphasize remote high-altitude rock landscapes and challenging verticality.

countries.title: TURKMENISTAN — Yangykala Canyon Journey
countries.environment: Create spectacular layered canyon walls with bands of white, red, yellow, and orange mineral colors. Use sparse desert vegetation and open skies.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a broad canyon rim, descend through terraced rocks, use a moving stone platform, and cross a lower canyon path.
countries.optionalRoute: A high isolated rock terrace contains a star.
countries.discovery: Yangykala's unusual layered geological formations.
countries.visualRequirement: Turkmenistan should have strong striped rock formations, visibly different from Kazakhstan's red canyon.

countries.title: UZBEKISTAN — Samarkand Silk Road Adventure
countries.environment: Create turquoise-tiled domes, mosaic-covered architectural facades, monumental courtyards, stone passages, and historic urban scenery.
countries.mainRoute: The player begins in a fictional courtyard, activates a gate, crosses raised stone passages, and reaches a scenic terrace.
countries.optionalRoute: A raised gallery contains a star.
countries.discovery: Samarkand's historical importance along Silk Road trade networks.
countries.visualRequirement: Protect real historic structures as scenic landmarks, keeping interactive mechanisms in clearly fictional extensions.

countries.title: ARMENIA — Garni Basalt Gorge
countries.location: Garni Gorge / Symphony of Stones landscape
countries.environment: Create dramatic hexagonal basalt formations, rocky cliffs, river valleys, and Armenian highland vegetation. The Garni Temple may appear as a distant contextual landmark in an appropriate composition.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a rocky trail, descend toward the gorge, cross several basalt ledges, and climb to an overlook.
countries.optionalRoute: A difficult column-top route contains a star.
countries.discovery: Basalt column formation.
countries.visualRequirement: The hexagonal geometry should define the level's visual identity.

countries.title: AZERBAIJAN — Gobustan Mud Volcano Expedition
countries.environment: Create barren mineral hills, shallow mud pools, small mud-volcano cones, dry earth, and distant Caspian-region landscapes.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on compacted earth, cross several elevated mineral platforms, wait for a mud eruption to finish, and reach a rocky overlook.
countries.optionalRoute: A higher mineral ledge contains a star.
countries.discovery: Mud volcanoes and their geological formation.
countries.visualRequirement: Do not place protected rock-art artifacts in the hazard zone or present them as destructible objects.

countries.title: BAHRAIN — Coastal Fort and Harbor
countries.environment: Create an archaeological coastal setting with stone fort silhouettes, sandy coastal ground, waterfront paths, and small harbor structures.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a wide stone promenade, cross a short wooden pier, ride one simple moving platform, and reach an elevated coastal viewpoint.
countries.optionalRoute: A small safe terrace contains a star.
countries.discovery: Bahrain's historic maritime trade connections.
countries.visualRequirement: Use fictional walkable structures near the heritage landscape rather than making the actual fort destructible.

countries.title: CYPRUS — Troodos Mountain Villages
countries.signatureMechanic: Terraced stone walkways and small lifts
countries.environment: Create pine-covered mountains, traditional stone villages, terraced slopes, winding paths, and clear Mediterranean light.
countries.mainRoute: Begin in a village square, cross short stone walkways, climb a hillside stair route, and finish at a pine-forest viewpoint.
countries.optionalRoute: An elevated stone balcony contains a star.
countries.discovery: Troodos mountain geography and traditional village architecture.
countries.visualRequirement: Cyprus should look mountainous and Mediterranean, not like a generic desert.

countries.title: GEORGIA — Svaneti Tower Village Expedition
countries.signatureMechanic: Steep paths and moving wooden lifts
countries.environment: Create high Caucasus mountains, grassy alpine valleys, stone defensive towers, mountain streams, and traditional village architecture.
countries.mainRoute: The player begins near a mountain village, climbs successive stone terraces, crosses an elevated path, rides a wooden lift, and finishes at a mountain lookout.
countries.optionalRoute: A high rocky trail contains a star.
countries.discovery: Svaneti's traditional tower architecture.
countries.visualRequirement: Keep historic towers as cultural scenery; use fictional walkable platforms and structures for jumps.

countries.title: IRAQ — Mesopotamian Marshes Adventure
countries.environment: Create reed beds, shallow waterways, marsh islands, traditional reed structures, birds, and warm sky reflections.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a dry marsh island, cross a wooden walkway, board a slow reed-boat-inspired platform, and continue to a raised observation area.
countries.optionalRoute: An elevated reed walkway contains a star.
countries.discovery: The ecology and cultural significance of the Mesopotamian Marshes.
countries.visualRequirement: Iraq should be represented by this distinctive wetland landscape, not automatically by war or barren desert imagery.

countries.title: ISRAEL — Masada Desert Plateau
countries.signatureMechanic: Narrow stone trails and wind-exposed ledges
countries.environment: Create arid rocky cliffs, pale desert mountains, distant Dead Sea views, and archaeological structures in appropriate scenic areas.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a desert foothill, traverse a narrow but safe cliff path, climb stone ledges, and reach a high plateau viewpoint.
countries.optionalRoute: A difficult desert overlook contains a star.
countries.discovery: Masada's geography and archaeological setting.
countries.visualRequirement: Avoid political conflict imagery or damage to protected archaeological structures.

countries.title: JORDAN — Petra Canyon Adventure
countries.signatureMechanic: Stone passage puzzles and moving gates
countries.environment: Create towering rose-colored sandstone canyon walls, winding passages, carved architectural facades, and warm reflected light.
countries.mainRoute: Begin in a narrow canyon, follow a winding rock passage, climb small sandstone ledges, activate a stone mechanism, and reach a scenic view of Petra-inspired architecture.
countries.optionalRoute: An upper canyon trail contains a star.
countries.discovery: Petra's rock-cut architecture and historical significance.
countries.visualRequirement: The narrow canyon should define the visual composition, not generic isolated floating rocks.

countries.title: KUWAIT — Coastal City Promenade
countries.environment: Create a modern city coastline with the Kuwait Towers visible as a landmark, landscaped promenades, waterfront buildings, and calm sea views.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a broad promenade, cross a short pier, ride a simple moving platform, and reach an elevated observation deck.
countries.optionalRoute: An accessible raised walkway contains a star.
countries.discovery: Kuwait City's coastal geography and recognizable skyline.
countries.visualRequirement: Keep the scene bright, open, modern, and beginner-friendly.

countries.title: LEBANON — Qadisha Valley Mountain Trails
countries.environment: Create steep green mountain valleys, rocky cliffs, cedar forests in appropriate nearby landscapes, and historic stone structures in the distance.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a forest trail, cross a stream, climb rocky ledges, traverse a narrow bridge, and reach a high mountain overlook.
countries.optionalRoute: An upper cliff trail contains a star.
countries.discovery: Lebanon's mountain landscapes and cedar heritage.
countries.visualRequirement: Respect historic religious structures and keep them as non-destructible scenery.

countries.title: OMAN — Wadi Shab Gorge Expedition
countries.environment: Create pale limestone cliffs, turquoise pools, narrow canyon passages, desert mountains, and scattered palms where appropriate.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a dry canyon path, climb natural stone ledges, cross water using moving platforms, enter a narrower gorge, and reach a final overlook.
countries.optionalRoute: A challenging high canyon ledge contains a star.
countries.discovery: Wadi formation and Oman's natural landscapes.
countries.visualRequirement: Oman should feel like a dramatic water-cut desert canyon, not a featureless sand desert.

countries.title: QATAR — Doha Skyline Adventure
countries.location: Doha Corniche and West Bay skyline
countries.environment: Create modern towers, landscaped waterfront paths, fountains, coastal water, and distinctive urban architecture.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a broad walkway, ascend an elevated platform, ride a moving lift, cross a rooftop terrace, and finish at a skyline viewpoint.
countries.optionalRoute: A higher observation deck contains a star.
countries.discovery: Doha's coastal urban development and geography.
countries.visualRequirement: Make Qatar visually different from Singapore and the UAE through its selected skyline, materials, and route structure.

countries.title: SAUDI ARABIA — AlUla Sandstone Expedition
countries.layout: Canyon exploration and complex stone traversal
countries.signatureMechanic: Sandstone ledges and light-based environmental puzzles
countries.environment: Create enormous natural sandstone formations, narrow valleys, desert vegetation, and ancient rock-cut architectural references. Use dramatic warm light and textured rock.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a wide valley floor, climb sandstone steps, traverse a narrow rock passage, activate a light-sensitive fictional mechanism, and finish at an elevated desert panorama.
countries.optionalRoute: A difficult upper sandstone crossing contains a star.
countries.discovery: AlUla's desert landscape and archaeological heritage.
countries.visualRequirement: Do not use protected tomb facades as destructible or climbable hazards.

countries.title: SYRIA — Palmyra-Inspired Oasis Landscape
countries.location: Historic Palmyra region, represented through a fictional non-destructive adventure environment
countries.layout: Ancient oasis and stone colonnade traversal
countries.environment: Create desert plains, palm groves around an oasis, historic-inspired colonnade silhouettes, weathered stone structures, and distant mountains. Use warm light and atmospheric haze.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a sandy path, cross stone terraces, use a fictional ancient mechanism to raise a platform, and continue to a high observation area.
countries.optionalRoute: An upper stone passage contains a star.
countries.discovery: The historic importance of Palmyra as an ancient trading center.
countries.visualRequirement: Use culturally respectful historical representation without depicting contemporary violence or damage to actual heritage sites as gameplay.

countries.title: TÜRKIYE — Cappadocia Valley Adventure
countries.signatureMechanic: Vertical cave lifts and rock passage puzzles
countries.environment: Create distinctive fairy-chimney rock formations, pale volcanic tuff cliffs, valleys, cave-like structures, and distant hot-air balloons as atmospheric scenery.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a valley floor, climb several natural stone ledges, enter a short cave passage, use a moving lift, and emerge onto a high overlook.
countries.optionalRoute: An upper rock formation contains a star.
countries.discovery: Cappadocia's volcanic landscape and erosion features.
countries.visualRequirement: Türkiye must have its recognizable fairy-chimney silhouettes rather than generic desert cliffs.

countries.title: UNITED ARAB EMIRATES — Dubai Skyline Adventure
countries.signatureMechanic: Vertical elevators and moving urban bridges
countries.environment: Create modern glass towers, elevated gardens, waterfront promenades, and the Burj Khalifa as a distant recognizable skyline landmark. Use reflective building materials, decorative lighting, and detailed urban architecture.
countries.mainRoute: Begin on a broad waterfront terrace, ride a maintenance lift, cross two elevated pedestrian structures, and reach a high garden viewpoint.
countries.optionalRoute: An optional rooftop-like platform contains a star.
countries.discovery: Dubai's modern urban architecture.
countries.visualRequirement: Avoid making the player unrealistically jump between the actual tops of famous skyscrapers. Use fictional lower-level urban structures.

countries.title: YEMEN — Socotra Island Highlands
countries.layout: Island highland climbing and coastal descent
countries.signatureMechanic: Irregular rock slopes and changing wind
countries.environment: Create Socotra's distinctive dragon's blood trees, dry rocky highlands, unusual plant forms, limestone plateaus, and distant turquoise coastlines. Use warm sunlight and strong landscape silhouettes.
countries.mainRoute: Begin in an open highland environment, cross uneven rock platforms, climb a narrow ridge, and descend toward a coastal viewpoint.
countries.optionalRoute: A more demanding upper plateau contains a star.
countries.discovery: Socotra's unique plant biodiversity and island ecosystems.
countries.visualRequirement: Dragon's blood trees should be carefully modeled as distinctive environmental features. Do not require players to damage protected vegetation.
